h: Wike's Rainbow Coalition publishes its 2027 candidate list for Rivers, as an APC governor says it has no presence in his state
p: Wike's Rainbow Coalition has reportedly released its list of candidates for the 2027 elections in Rivers State. Separately, an APC governor has publicly challenged the group, saying no such coalition exists in his own state. The back-and-forth shows the growing contest over alliances ahead of the polls.
more: The coalition lists Rivers candidates for the 2027 general election.
The APC governor disputed claims that the coalition has a base in his state.
